application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Trees: T24, T25, T26 — TPO 7/1976
Description of Proposed Works:
Crown reduction to previous pruning points in accordance with BS 3998:2010, retaining the established pruning framework. All pruning cuts to be made to suitable secondary branches or growth points of adequate size to aid compartmentalisation and minimise the risk of decay. The works will restore and maintain the trees within their current size and shape envelope.
Removal of epicormic growth from stems and primary scaffold branches throughout, to suppress regenerative suckering, maintain crown clarity and prevent progressive encroachment upon adjacent railings and highway infrastructure (pavement).
All works to be carried out by a competent arborist in accordance with BS 3998:2010 Recommendations for Tree Work.
Reasons for Works:
To maintain the trees within their established size and shape, manage epicormic growth arising from previous reduction works, and prevent ongoing and future damage to adjacent railings and public pavement.
Frequency: Annually
decision_conditions:
TREE WORKS (COMPLIANCE):  All tree work shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998 - Recommendations for Tree Work.  In addition: 
a)   No fires shall be lit within [10] metres of the nearest point of the canopy of any retained tree.  No equipment, machinery or structure shall be attached to or supported by a retained tree.
b)   No mixing of cement or use of other contaminating materials or substances shall take place within, or close enough to, a root protection area that seepage or displacement could cause them to enter a root protection area. 
c)   No alterations or variations to the approved works or tree protection schemes shall be made without prior written consent of the local planning authority.

REASON:  In the interest of the protection of trees and to safeguard visual amenities.
